title_en: Good News (5/20): A Breakthrough in Cancer Research
note_en: 之所以…是因为… is a formal way to explain a reason that puts the result first: 这项技术之所以重要，是因为早期发现往往意味着更高的治愈率 "the reason this technology matters is that early detection often means a higher cure rate." It works like English "the reason (why)… is that…": 之所以 comes right after the subject, and 是因为 opens the explanation.
